description: WattCoin: Install a FREE marketplace skill and record the install against your wallet, which rate_skill requires. Paid skills are refused. Use get_skill first to check price and permissions. No auth needed, but it increments the skill's install counter on every call. Returns JSON with download_url (public install URL), size_bytes, sha256 and permissions; the ZIP itself is never returned.

wallet.description: Solana wallet address, base58, 32-44 characters (e.g. 7vvNk...). The install is recorded against it, and rate_skill must use the same wallet

name: install_skill
title: WattCoin: Install skill
